test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 8 percent on simple interest and the interest received in 9 years is Rs. 560 less than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
solution:
Given:

A person lent a certain sum of money at the annual rate of 8 percent on simple interest and the interest received in 9 years is Rs. 560 less than the sum lent. 

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]
